key_idea: Read every sock's number, then match the socks that have the same number.
steps: Match the same numbers: two 1s, two 2s, two 4s and two 6s.
The 9 and the 3 have no partner.

choice_feedback.A: Look again. The 4s and the 6s make pairs too.
choice_feedback.B: Look again. There is one more pair to find.
choice_feedback.C: The 9 and the 3 have no partner, so they do not make a pair.
choice_feedback.E: There are only 10 socks. 6 pairs would need 12 socks.
